answers.question: withheld: OSM joins no footway to the platforms and tags no entrance
answers.answer: Settled from Trafikverket (owner): since 30 May 2026 passenger trains stop only at spår 1 (east side) and the new spår 30 (west side); the at-grade crossing and middle platform are gone (removed August 2026). The two platforms are linked by the red footbridge (OSM w979570484, stairs both ends, no lift until a planned 2027 install) or the nearby Hagatunneln; platform 30 can also be reached directly from Svartå Bangata in the west. The station is not step-free; Trafikverket refers those needing step-free access to Örebro Central. OSM has platform 1 (w92083221) and 30 (w1491812320) and the footbridge reaching both, but still no entrance nodes.
